section-title.looks: A section's heading with an optional intro paragraph and an optional button, aligned left, centre or right.
section-title.use: Opening a section whose blocks have no heading of their own, e.g. above a row of cards.
section-title.avoid: A heading alone with nothing else: Custom Heading is lighter.

fields.title: The heading. Each paragraph shows on its own line.
fields.subtitle: One or two sentences.
fields.buttonText: Optional button under the intro, with buttonLink.
fields.textAlign: left (default), center or right. Match the block below: centre over centred cards.
